Limits.description: What the client allows an asset-backed guard while it runs. A built-in guard runs in the client's own process; the client applies what it can.

timeout_seconds.description: The longest the guard may run, at most a day. Overrunning it counts as could not evaluate (exit 2).
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds

network.description: Whether the guard may reach the network. Absent means false.
network.title: Network

Limits.title: Limits

YamlWord.description: A word a YAML 1.1 reader takes for a boolean or null (core reads packs with one, so an id of this word would be read as true, false or null there).
YamlWord.title: YamlWord

description: An enforced check a transition names (ADR-0054): implemented_by an executable asset or a closed built-in, run to the guard/1 interface, failing closed. A guard carries no severity; whether a failure blocks is the transition entry's blocking.

id.description: The guard's id, kebab-case; it is the file stem.
id.title: Id

interface.description: The interface the guard is run to: one JSON object on stdin; exit 0 pass, 1 fail, 2 could not evaluate; a verdict on stdout.
interface.title: Interface

implemented_by.description: The guard's one implementation: asset:<id> (an asset of this pack that declares an executable block), <pack>::asset:<id> (an asset of another pack), or builtin:<id> from the closed list the client's own code implements.
implemented_by.title: Implemented By

config_schema.description: A JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) that a transition entry's config is checked against at load. Its content is open: it is itself a schema, checked at load against the draft 2020-12 meta-schema and compiled offline, as the bundled schemas are: an unknown keyword is refused, and so is every reference keyword anywhere in it ($ref, $dynamicRef, $dynamicAnchor, $recursiveRef, $recursiveAnchor, $anchor), which the load check enforces and this schema does not express. Its patterns are evaluated as RE2 expressions (linear time; a backreference or lookaround is refused) (ADR-0042 S4 as amended). format is an annotation, not checked.
config_schema.title: Config Schema

on_indeterminate.description: What a could-not-evaluate result counts as: block (when absent) or pass. The guard author's decision, stated in the file (ADR-0054 decision 8).
on_indeterminate.title: On Indeterminate

title: Guard
